Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Data Scientist
description:

  • Machine Learning: Expertise in machine learning concepts and algorithms.
  • Data Manipulation: Experience with data cleaning, feature engineering, and building scalable data pipelines (e.g., with Airflow and Trino).
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to explain complex ideas to various stakeholders.
  • Analytical: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to tackle complex financial crime challenges.

Education: A degree in a quantitative field like Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related area is often required.

  • Develop the overall structure and framework for the Disaster Recovery Program, including roles, responsibilities, and governance.

Você tem interesse em tecnologia, sustentabilidade e soluções energéticas inovadoras? Esta é uma oportunidade para quem deseja atuar na fronteira da transição energética, desenvolvendo tecnologias que impulsionam a economia circular e reduzem impactos ambientais.

Buscamos um profissional com visão integrada e capacidade analítica para desenvolver e validar uma solução tecnológica de segunda vida para baterias de íon-lítio, conectando hardware, software e protocolos avançados de segurança. Mais do que uma função técnica, trata-se de um papel estratégico — voltado à inovação sustentável, análise de viabilidade econômica, desenvolvimento de protótipos, integração de tecnologias digitais e construção de soluções escaláveis que contribuam diretamente para a transição energética no país.

Se você busca um desafio que una tecnologia, impacto ambiental positivo e visão de futuro, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de soluções energéticas mais limpas, seguras e economicamente viáveis, esta oportunidade é para você.



Projeto:

Desenvolvimento de Tecnologias para a Segunda Vida de Baterias usadas em Veículos Elétricos e Híbridos


Formação:

Doutorado em Engenharia Elétrica, Ciência de Dados, eletroquímica ou áreas correlatas.


Idioma: inglês técnico basico


Essa vaga afirmativa é para talentos diversos — Pessoa com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras (pretas e pardas), Pessoas 45+, Comunidade LGBTQI+ e Mulheres (Cis e Trans).


Principais Atividades:


  • Desenvolver e validar uma solução tecnológica de segunda vida para baterias de íon-lítio.
  • Integrar hardware, software e protocolos de segurança em um sistema completo e confiável.
  • Adaptar as baterias recondicionadas para aplicações de armazenamento estacionário de energia.
  • Promover economia circular por meio do reaproveitamento de baterias descartadas pela indústria automotiva e outros setores.
  • Reduzir impactos ambientais relacionados ao descarte e à produção de novos materiais.
  • Avaliar e garantir a viabilidade econômica da solução dentro do contexto da transição energética.
  • Contribuir para o avanço de tecnologias sustentáveis e para o fortalecimento do ecossistema de energia limpa no país.


Conhecimentos e habilidades necessários:


  • Eletromobilidade e suas aplicações tecnológicas.
  • Baterias de íon-lítio, incluindo funcionamento, degradação e reuso.
  • Machine Learning aplicado à energia, para análise, predição e otimização de desempenho.
  • Desenvolvimento de hardware embarcado, incluindo sensores, microcontroladores e sistemas de monitoramento.
  • Integração de sistemas de energia, com foco em eficiência, segurança e interoperabilidade.



Conhecimentos e habilidades desejáveis:

  • Liderança em Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I), com capacidade de conduzir projetos técnicos e interdisciplinares.
  • Trabalho colaborativo em ecossistemas de inovação, envolvendo empresas, universidades, laboratórios e parceiros tecnológicos.

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!


MoveUp Media

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).

  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact

O que oferecemos:

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

description:

title: Líder de Fábrica de Software SAP ABAP e BW
description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Líder de Fábrica de Software SAP ABAP e BW


Remoto - Brasil.

Horário - Comercial.


Procuramos profissional experiente para conduzir e desenvolver equipes SAP ABAP e BW. Profissional focado em liderança técnica, governança de entregas e capacitação de times, que será o ponto focal de sustentação e projetos.


Responsabilidades:

  • Mapear competências técnicas e gaps da equipe, identificando planos de desenvolvimento individuais;
  • Promover e estruturar a fábrica de ABAP, definindo processos, padrões e boas práticas;
  • Definir, implantar e acompanhar o programa de capacitação e certificação das equipes;
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento de profissionais em início de carreira e de novos consultores, garantindo ramp-up eficiente;
  • Organizar a cobertura de férias, assegurando continuidade das entregas;
  • Acompanhar e garantir o apontamento correto de horas e conformidade com políticas internas;
  • Apoiar processos de contratação e desligamento de consultores, em alinhamento com RH;
  • Atuar como ponto focal para suporte técnico às equipes de sustentação e para demandas de projetos;
  • Colaborar com a gerência e stakeholders para priorização de demandas e mitigação de riscos técnicos.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em liderança de equipes técnicas SAP ABAP e BW;
  • Habilidade em mapear competências, estruturar equipes e implantar programas de capacitação;
  • Experiência na organização de cobertura de férias, gestão de apontamento de horas e suporte a processos de contratação/desligamento;
  • Boa comunicação com stakeholders e capacidade de atuar como ponto focal entre sustentação e projetos;
  • Excelentes conhecimento técnico em SAP ABAP (PI/PO, BTP, Workflow e Integrações);
  • Experiência prática com SAP BW (modelos, extração/transformação, carregamento e performance);
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis e governança de fábrica de desenvolvimento;
  • Graduação completa.


Qualificações desejáveis:

  • Familiaridade com BASIS;
  • Experiência anterior em estruturação de programas de treinamento/capacitação/bootcamps;
  • Certificações SAP e/ou experiência em projetos de grande porte;
  • Inglês intermediário.


Benefícios:

  • Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação;
  • Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Programa de remuneração variável;
  • Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos;
  • Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa);
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas);
  • Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas);
  • Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)
  • Programa de treinamentos internos e externos;
  • Universidade corporativa (E-learning com milhares de cursos disponíveis gratuitamente);
  • Espaço Saúde (suporte com atendimento médico - presencial ou online - para os funcionários e seus familiares e contamos também com os programas de bem-estar e qualidade de vida);
  • Terapia online;
  • Programa de acompanhamento à gestante (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras ou cônjuges);
  • Programa Minha Nova Parceria de Confiança (para colaboradores e cônjuges. Válido também para filhos adotivos) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro;
  • Day off no seu aniversário;
  • Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos);
  • Bônus de indicação para nossas vagas (conforme política interna);
  • Jubileu (premiação personalizada por tempo de empresa);
  • Accolade (Programa de reconhecimento).


Aviso de Diversidade

Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Todas as nossas oportunidades são Afirmativas para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Valorizamos a diversidade independentemente de identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, nacionalidade ou qualquer outro aspecto.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

  • The client operates a global employment technology platform that connects millions of job seekers with companies through a large-scale search engine for job opportunities.
  • The organization is highly data-driven and focuses on building reliable, high-availability systems to support large volumes of traffic and data processing.
  • Their mission centers on improving access to employment through technology, analytics, and scalable infrastructure.
  • The culture emphasizes large-scale data engineering, experimentation, and operational excellence across distributed systems.


About the role

  • We are looking for a Data Engineer with strong experience in modern data platforms to support a large-scale migration initiative to Snowflake.
  • The role focuses on migrating approximately 1,000 datasets while adapting existing pipelines and workflows to a new architecture.
  • You will work with orchestration tools and cloud-based data lakes to ensure reliability, performance, and data quality.
  • The architecture is already defined internally, so the role is execution-focused and highly hands-on.
  • This position requires strong expertise in SQL, Python, and distributed data processing tools.


Responsibilities

  • Execute the migration of approximately 1,000 datasets to Snowflake.
  • Adapt and refactor existing data pipelines to align with the Snowflake architecture.
  • Develop and test pipelines using Python and Apache Airflow.
  • Support workflow orchestration, scheduling, and monitoring in Apache Airflow.
  • Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across migrated datasets.
  • Work with data stored in AWS S3 data lakes, including partitioning and lifecycle policies.
  • Implement testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Collaborate with internal teams following the predefined architecture and technical approach.
  • Work with streaming or event-driven data using Apache Kafka.
  • Support distributed processing workloads using Apache Spark.


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of experience in Data Engineering or related roles.
  • 7+ years of experience with Python (7–9 years).
  • Advanced SQL (complex joins, CTEs, window functions, performance tuning).
  • Snowflake (data modeling and pipeline integration).
  • Apache Airflow (pipeline development and orchestration).
  • Apache Spark (distributed data processing).
  • Apache Kafka.
  • AWS experience, especially S3 (data lakes, partitioning, lifecycle policies).
  • Experience in defining and implementing testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining production-grade data pipelines.


Nice to have skills

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake migrations (data warehouse modernization, performance optimization, cost optimization).
  • Experience with Apache Airflow migrations (version upgrades, executor changes, or platform migrations).


Conditions

  • Remote role (100% remote). Primary timezone: UTC-6 with at least 8 hours of overlap required.
  • Contractor role (initially 3-month contract, but renewable: expected overall duration up to 12 months).
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week).
  • BYOD required (bring your own device).



At Andela, we know our strengths lie in our diverse community whose talents, perspectives, backgrounds and orientations we take pride in. Andela is committed to nurturing a work environment where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. Everyone has the right to work in a professional atmosphere that promotes equal employment opportunities and prohibits discriminatory practices.

Andela provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to factors including but not limited to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy (including breastfeeding), genetic information, HIV/AIDS or any other medical status, family or parental status, marital status, amnesty or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. This commitment applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including but not limited to hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Our policies expressly prohibit any form of harassment and/or discrimination, as stated above.

title: Clinical Statistical Programmer (SAS / CDISC)
description:
Job Title: Clinical Statistical Programmer (SAS / CDISC)

Location - Brazil


Role Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented Clinical Statistical Programmer to support clinical trial data standardization, analysis, and regulatory submissions. title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Inbound Team)
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – AI/ML Customer Science (Remote – Brazil)


Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ – Long term


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.


What You’ll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems


Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices (feature engineering, experimentation, pipelines, model evaluation)
  • Experience with modern ML techniques including gradient boosting, deep learning, transformers, and optimization
  • Experience in Computer Vision (Causal Inference experience is a strong plus)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools such as Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • Experience applying ML in retail or commercial business contexts
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and production pipelines
  • Strong leadership and mentoring experience
  • Impact-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality, scalable solutions

description:

Mobiis

Região Norte



Sobre a vaga


Buscamos Representantes Comerciais (RCA) com forte perfil hunter , foco em prospecção ativa, abertura de mercado e fechamento de novos contratos , para expandir a presença da Mobiis em diferentes regiões do Brasil.

title: Mid/Senior Devops
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join a strategic cloud migration initiative, transitioning workloads from Azure to AWS within a structured modernization program.

This professional will play a key role in supporting the technical execution of the migration, ensuring infrastructure standardization, automation, CI/CD pipeline implementation, environment readiness, observability, and post-migration operational validation.


The project follows a Lift & Shift / Replatform approach, covering infrastructure preparation, security, networking, service equivalency mapping, migration execution, testing, stabilization, and post-cutover operational readiness.


Key Responsibilities


  • Prepare and standardize AWS environments (VPC, IAM, networking, security, logging).
  • Support migrations using AWS MGN, DMS, and SCT.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
  • Manage Infrastructure as Code with Terraform.
  • Implement monitoring and observability (CloudWatch, X-Ray, Grafana).
  • Validate application, database, and network functionality post-migration.
  • Support performance, scalability, and security testing.
  • Contribute to documentation and runbooks.


What do you need to know?


  • Cloud & Migration: AWS (EC2, EKS/ECS, S3, Aurora, VPC, ALB/NLB, Route 53, IAM, KMS), Azure (VMs, AKS, SQL, App Services)
  • DevOps & Automation: Terraform, Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps), Python/Bash/PowerShell
  • Migration Tools: AWS MGN, DMS, SCT
  • Integrations & Monitoring: Kafka, Snowflake, Elasticsearch, Datadog

title: Médico Endocrinologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

description:

- Modelos de linguagem

- Prompts

- Agentes

  • Definir e implementar guardrails corporativos, políticas de segurança, privacidade, compliance regulatório e governança de IA.

  • Domínio avançado em IA Generativa e LLMs, incluindo:

- Avaliação automática e humana de LLMs

  • Forte experiência em arquiteturas de agentes autônomos, incluindo:

- Agentes multi-step e multi-agent

- Comunicação A2A (Agent-to-Agent)

- Planejamento, raciocínio, memória de curto e longo prazo e execução

title: Senior AI/ML Developer
description:
About The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Developer to lead the technical development of an Industrial RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solution for a major US-based client. The project addresses a critical challenge: transitioning 25 years of historical lab reports from SharePoint into an intelligent, GenAI-powered knowledge retrieval system.

You will be responsible for building a two-phase solution, starting with a Proof of Concept (POC) for a Pricing Analyst Agent and evolving into a Production-Ready Conversational AI Agent. This role focuses on automating knowledge retrieval, preserving institutional expertise, and enhancing the accuracy of fluid design processes through scalable AWS architectures.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and validate robust AI architectures leveraging AWS Infrastructure, specifically Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker.
  • Create GenAI pipelines and multi-agent workflows using AWS Step Functions, Lambda, and EventBridge.
  • Design platforms for processing massive volumes of unstructured data (text, image, audio, and video) integrated with RAG patterns.
  • Build interactive front-ends and AI dashboards using Streamlit for demos and operational workflows.
  • Implement best practices for AI governance, security, and observability using AWS IAM and CloudWatch.
  • Fine-tune pricing normalization and data retrieval to reduce bid risk and improve decision accuracy.


Required Qualifications

  • Good English communication skills (mandatory for direct collaboration with US stakeholders).
  • Proven hands-on experience building real-world GenAI applications using commercial LLMs.
  • Deep technical knowledge of the AWS ecosystem, including Serverless architectures and AI-specific services.
  • Strong experience building intelligent pipelines and event-oriented architectures.
  • Ability to design, test, and evaluate prompt engineering strategies and agentic frameworks.
  • Experience handling complex, unstructured data sources at scale.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with industrial-scale data migrations (SharePoint to Cloud).
  • Background in data science, specifically related to pricing normalization or cost baselines.
  • AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty or AWS Certified AI Practitioner certifications.

What We Offer:

title: Business Intelligence Analyst | Tableau
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a leading workforce and technology solutions provider delivering innovative, data-driven services to enterprise clients worldwide. We combine deep technical expertise with strong business acumen to help organizations modernize systems, optimize performance, and unlock the value of their data. Our teams partner closely with stakeholders to translate complex business needs into scalable, impactful solutions. At Pinnacle Group, we foster collaboration, continuous learning, and measurable results.


Summary

We are seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst | Tableau who will serve as both a functional and technical partner to the business. This role is responsible for gathering requirements, defining KPIs, and designing robust Tableau dashboards using advanced calculations and Level of Detail (LOD) expressions. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, business-focused, and capable of building scalable reporting solutions from scratch. This position requires strong stakeholder engagement skills and deep expertise in Tableau development.


Job Description

  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather and document reporting requirements, define success metrics, and establish actionable KPIs.
  • Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end Tableau dashboards from scratch using complex calculations and advanced LOD expressions.
  • Translate business questions into scalable data models, visualizations, and performance-driven analytics solutions.
  • Create calculated fields, parameters, filters, and data blending solutions to support dynamic reporting needs.
  • Perform data validation, quality checks, and reconciliation to ensure accuracy and consistency of insights.
  • Optimize dashboard performance through efficient data modeling and query tuning.
  • Present findings and insights to business leaders, translating technical outputs into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Continuously enhance reporting frameworks by identifying automation opportunities and implementing best practices in BI development.


Requirements

  • 3–5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence or Data Analytics with strong Tableau development expertise.
  • Demonstrated experience creating dashboards from scratch using complex calculations and LOD expressions.
  • Proven ability to gather business requirements and translate them into measurable KPIs and reporting solutions.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases and large datasets.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts and performance optimization techniques.
  • Ability to balance technical execution with business-facing communication and stakeholder management.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you will work on high-impact initiatives that directly influence business strategy and decision-making. We empower our employees to take ownership of their work while providing the support and resources needed for professional growth. Our collaborative environment encourages innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning. Joining our team means contributing to meaningful data-driven transformation while advancing your career in a dynamic, forward-thinking organization.


Instructions

Please answer the questions below, attach your resume and email your responses to the correct contacts as part of your application. Please email your resume and responses to: and .


  • Describe your experience building Tableau dashboards from scratch, including how many you have created, examples of complex calculations, LOD expressions you have implemented.
  • How do you approach gathering business requirements and translating them into measurable KPIs?
  • Please share anything else you would like us to know that highlights your strengths or sets you apart as a Business Intelligence Analyst specialized in Tableau dashboard creation.

title: Senior Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
Senior Data Pipeline Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure that powers our platform, building integrations, transformations, and orchestration that ensure reliable, analytics-ready data for hundreds of customer workspaces.


Position Overview:


For our Client we're hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure powering our platform. You'll build integrations from marketing and sales platforms, transform raw data into analytics-ready models, and orchestrate pipelines that run reliably across hundreds of customer workspaces. This foundational role requires architectural thinking, experience with ELT patterns, columnar storage, and multi-tenant systems. If you love designing clean data models, building robust pipelines, and connecting new data sources end-to-end, this is the role for you.


What You'll Do

  • Expand our data integrations — add new source connectors (ad platforms, social media, payment processors) with full extraction, loading, transformation, and orchestration flows
  • Write and maintain incremental SQL transformation models across staging, core, and analytics layers optimized for a columnar analytics engine
  • Design and maintain orchestration workflows — event-driven sensors, schedules, partitions, and automated pipeline chains
  • Optimize our analytics warehouse — schema design, partitioning strategies, materialized views, sort keys, and data retention policies for performance at scale
  • Scale our multi-tenant architecture — each customer workspace gets isolated databases, and you'll manage the per-tenant pipeline lifecycle
  • Build data quality checks, freshness monitoring, alerting, and pipeline health dashboards


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data engineering — we care about your growth trajectory, not just time served
  • Strong SQL skills — CTEs, window functions, complex aggregations, and performance tuning for analytical workloads
  • Production experience with columnar analytics databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar OLAP engines)
  • Hands-on experience with ELT pipelines and SQL transformation frameworks (dbt or similar)
  • Experience with modern data orchestration tools (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, or similar)
  • Comfortable writing data pipeline code in Python
  • Experience with cloud-based data integration platforms for managing source connectors and sync configurations
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with marketing and ads platform APIs (TikTok, Meta, Google Ads, Pinterest)
  • Background in multi-tenant data architecture — per-customer database isolation and credential management
  • E-commerce domain knowledge — orders, customers, transactions, RFM segmentation, customer lifetime value
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and cross-database patterns between relational and analytical databases
  • Familiarity with Next.js or TypeScript — our console is built with Next.js, and wiring integrations into the frontend is a plus
  • Understanding of how data models feed into AI/LLM agent systems


Who You Are

  • You have a genuine drive to learn and grow — we hire for potential and curiosity as much as current skill
  • You think in systems — you see how extraction, transformation, orchestration, and the analytics layer fit together as one whole
  • You take ownership end-to-end — from designing the schema to monitoring the pipeline in production
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and can make sound architectural decisions without a playbook for every situation
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy working directly with founders and cross-functional teammates


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.

title: Senior API Engineer (NodeJS, TS, SDUI)
description:
About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role summary:

Lead the design and operation of APIs that power Server-Driven UI for Flutter clients while owning backend services across the stack. You’ll design stable UI contracts and compose client payloads, be comfortable diving into other backend codebases to implement features and fix production issues, participate in the on-call rotation to keep services healthy and low-latency, and drive team capability for SDUI.


Key responsibilities:

  • Design and implement robust RESTful APIs for SDUI, auth, and rate limiting.
  • Implement composition/templating logic that returns client-ready UI payloads with capability-aware fallbacks.
  • Champion SDUI capability across the team: coach engineers, run hands-on workshops, create onboarding/docs, and promote SDUI best practices.
  • Work across multiple backend repositories: add features, refactor, and maintain code quality.
  • Operate production services: own SLAs, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and participate in on-call rotation.
  • Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing).
  • Build and maintain CI/CD, testing, and observability (metrics, tracing, logs, dashboards).
  • Integrate personalization, experimentation hooks, and feature flags into the delivery flow.
  • Collaborate closely with mobile/web teams to define contracts and client compatibility.
  • Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.


Required skills & experience:

  • 7+ years building production microservices and APIs.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design.
  • Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems.
  • Hands-on development in TypeScript for backend services.
  • Proven RESTful API design and contract experience.
  • Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies.
  • Strong with AWS (API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents).
  • Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers).
  • Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification.
  • Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties.
  • Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.).
  • Good spoken English


Nice to have:

  • Terraform or other IaC for managing AWS resources.
  • Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts).
  • Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics.
  • Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos).
  • Background in personalization/experimentation systems.
  • Hands-on development in Python for backend services.


Hiring signals:

  • Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements.
  • Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns.
  • Evidence of effective on-call ownership: resolved incidents, improved runbooks/alerts, postmortems.
  • Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.


Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Brazil - Remote: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from \"Bronze\" (Raw) to \"Silver\" (Cleaned) and \"Gold\" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

What You’ll Do

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute : Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clustrers (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.


Qualifications


Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks .
  • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills.
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don't just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Gerente Soluções – SAP


Local: Híbrido 2 vezes por semana em São Paulo (Capital).

Horário: 09:00 – 18:00.


Buscamos Gerente Soluções SAP Sênior, para integrar nosso time de pré-vendas. O profissional atuará em apoio direto à área comercial, definindo estratégias técnicas, coordenando entregas e garantindo propostas competitivas e aderentes às necessidades dos clientes.


Responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a equipe de vendas para identificar oportunidades e desenvolver estratégias SAP para os clientes;

  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e tecnologias em SAP e disseminar conhecimento na equipe.

  • Experiência comprovada em SAP, preferencialmente com atuação em pré-venda;

title: Solutions Architect
description:
JDA WMS Developer

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior JDA Warehouse Management System (WMS) Solution Architect to lead end to end solution design, integration, and delivery for global transformational programs. This role requires deep functional and technical expertise in JDA WMS (Discrete), exceptional communication skills, and the ability to operate in fast paced, multi vendor environments.

You will act as the primary JDA WMS expert across strategic initiatives, driving architecture, process optimization, integration design, and overall solution governance.

Desired Skills & Experience

• Bachelor’s or higher degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or Logistics.

• Strong hands-on experience with JDA Warehouse Management System (Discrete).

• Participation in 2–3 full end to end implementation projects.

• Strong domain knowledge of JDA WMS configuration, design, and delivery to support customer business processes.

• Extensive experience designing current and future-state architecture for enterprise clients.

• Deep expertise in:

o MOCA Components

o MTF

o DDA/Page Builder

o Reports & Labels

• Strong experience integrating JDA WMS with multiple host/destination systems using JDA Integrator/Connect.

• Experience using support tools, project management tools, and global SharePoint.

• Solid understanding of SDLC, requirement analysis, and solution design.

• Experience working in dynamic, fast-paced, multi-vendor environments.

• Approve solution designs and validate the configured JDA WMS solution.

• Validate test concepts, test scenarios, and user acceptance criteria.

• Serve as the primary JDA WMS expert for global transformation projects and programs.

• Advise customers on industry best practices and process methodology.

• Demonstrate and facilitate design, development, and integration discussions covering product functionality and architecture.

• Ensure smooth integration between technical and functional requirements across JDA modules.

• Proactively identify process improvement opportunities and ensure alignment with business stakeholders.

• Collaborate with Business, Service Delivery, and Service Providers in evaluating and approving new solutions.

• Drive improvements in global technology processes and service delivery.

• Lead business process analysis, design, construction, validation, and deployment phases.

• CCNP Certification (Required)

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or a related field.

• Advanced English


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

title: Especialista de Operações (Operations Specialist)
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Execute and maintain operational workflows for cross-border payments (including fiat and stablecoin transactions) and VASP activities.
  • Monitor transaction costs, identify inefficiencies, and propose improvements to enhance operational performance.
  • Manage daily financial operations, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow tracking, and crypto/stablecoin fund movements.
  • Maintain detailed records of all virtual asset activities to ensure compliance with internal
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal risk controls, including KYB/KYC/AML checks, reporting, and audit readiness.
  • Coordinate with banking partners, OTC desks, and internal teams to guarantee smooth settlement, reconciliation, and liquidity management.
  • Develop and implement scalable SOPs and operational tools to support business growth, ensuring reliability and consistency across markets.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, or crypto-related back-office roles, preferably in fintech or Web3 environments.
  • Solid understanding of stablecoins, blockchain-based payment flows, and operational risk.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus.


What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry.


Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus

Job type: Full Time


Responsabilidades:

  • Executar e manter fluxos de trabalho operacionais para pagamentos transfronteiriços (cross-border), incluindo transações em moeda fiduciária (fiat) e stablecoins, bem como atividades de VASP.
  • Monitorar custos de transação, identificar ineficiências e propor melhorias para aprimorar o desempenho operacional.
  • Gerenciar as operações financeiras diárias, incluindo contas a pagar/receber, rastreamento de fluxo de caixa e movimentações de fundos em cripto/stablecoins.
  • Manter registros detalhados de todas as atividades de ativos virtuais para garantir a conformidade com as políticas internas.
  • Assegurar a conformidade com requisitos regulatórios e controles de risco internos, incluindo verificações de KYB/KYC/AML, relatórios e preparação para auditorias.
  • Coordenar com parceiros bancários, mesas de OTC e equipes internas para garantir liquidação, reconciliação e gestão de liquidez tranquilas.
  • Desenvolver e implementar SOPs (Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão) escaláveis e ferramentas operacionais para apoiar o crescimento do negócio, garantindo confiabilidade e consistência entre os mercados.

Requisitos:

  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência em operações, operações financeiras ou funções de back-office relacionadas a cripto, preferencialmente em ambientes de fintech ou Web3.
  • Sólida compreensão de stablecoins, fluxos de pagamento baseados em blockchain e risco operacional.
  • Fortes habilidades organizacionais e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas com atenção aos detalhes.
  • Fluência em Português e Inglês; proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial.

O que oferecemos:

  • Salário e benefícios competitivos.
  • Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inovador.
  • A chance de trabalhar com tecnologia blockchain de ponta e causar um impacto significativo na indústria.

Qualificações Preferenciais:

  • Proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial.

Tipo de vaga: Tempo Integral

  • Termos Técnicos: Mantive termos como Stablecoin, VASP, OTC, SOPs e KYC/KYB/AML em inglês ou com a sigla original, pois são padrão na indústria de cripto no Brasil.
  • Adaptação Cultural: O tom é profissional, mas direto, típico de vagas de tecnologia no Brasil.

title: Sr DevOps Engineer Azure (Remoto | PJ)
description:
100% Remote

USA Timezone

Contractor / PJ position



Role Overview

The goal is to shape the reliability and scalability of mission-critical platforms on Azure, Kubernetes , and modern DevOps toolchains. You will solve complex infrastructure challenges, automate end-to-end operations, and ensure systems operate with high availability, performance, and security.


What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and improve CI/CD pipelines for applications and infrastructure
  • Develop automation frameworks that reduce manual effort and increase consistency.
  • Configure and optimize cloud infrastructure to align with security, scalability, and performance best practices.
  • Collaborate with development teams to remove deployment blockers and improve delivery workflows.
  • Monitor reliability and performance, identify issues early, and implement data-driven improvements to increase uptime and efficiency.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and drive incident resolution with clear postmortems and preventive actions.
  • Maintain technical documentation for pipelines, configurations, and runbooks.
  • Perform readiness assessments and validation tests before production rollouts.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and ARM templates with version control and reproducibility.
  • Troubleshoot complex deployment, provisioning, and performance issues across multi-cloud and containerized environments.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven track record in SRE or DevOps roles operating production systems
  • Hands-on experience running production workloads on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, including cluster design, autoscaling, upgrades, and network policies.
  • Proven CI/CD delivery using GitHub Actions or Jenkins , including promotion across environments, approvals, and rollback strategies.
  • Infrastructure as Code expertise with Terraform and ARM templates, including modules, remote state, workspaces, and policy enforcement.
  • Strong scripting in PowerShell, Bash, or Python for automation and diagnostics.
  • GitOps experience with Argo CD or Flux , managing multi-environment application delivery and drift remediation.
  • Containerization with Docker and Kubernetes , including health probes, PodDisruptionBudgets, resource quotas, HorizontalPodAutoscaler, and operators.
  • Networking fundamentals with cloud network security practices such as VNet design, NSGs, Private Link, and ingress controllers.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security and compliance, including least privilege, secrets management, audit trails, and control evidence.
  • Excellent written and spoken English .
  • Ability to collaborate across US time zone .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Azure certification , such as Developer Associate, Administrator, or DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Observability using Application Insights, Elastic Stack (ELK), Grafana, and Prometheus for metrics, logs, and traces.
  • Experience with log aggregation and alerting at scale using Elastic and Prometheus.
  • Understanding of high availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization strategies.
  • Experience managing Windows-based containerized applications .


Plus

  • Experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS

description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people.   • Develop, maintain, and evolve backend services and APIs that support digital platforms and applications

  • Contribute to proof-of-concept initiatives involving deterministic orchestration and rule-based evaluation
  • Integrate backend services with third-party APIs and external platforms
  • Build scalable and reliable backend systems following established best practices and architectural standards
  • Collaborate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives
  • Implement unit tests and ensure quality through proper testing and integration practices
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including product, QA, and engineering

  • Experience with NoSQL databases, particularly MongoDB
  • Knowledge of API development and integration
  • Experience writing and maintaining unit tests
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies, particularly Scrum
  • Fluent English (spoken and written)

title: Direct Response Video Editor
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Build the creative engine behind performance.

Portent Brands is a holding company scaling a portfolio of healthcare and ecommerce brands through performance creative and paid growth. We build brands that win at the unit economics level—and great creative is central to how we do it.


As our DTC Video Editor, you’ll own the full lifecycle of paid video creative across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and Google. You’ll work directly with our Creative Lead and Head of Growth—taking briefs from concept to final ad independently, then iterating fast based on what the data says.


This isn’t a brand-only role. Performance, output velocity, and creative precision are the metrics that matter here. You’ll use AI tools to compress production timelines, leverage motion design to elevate hooks, and bring a direct-response instinct to every cut.


Over time, you’ll become a core creative engine across Growth, CRO, and Product—shaping how our brands convert at scale.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own the output. Drive the numbers.

  • DTC Video Editing: Edit and ship conversion-focused video ads for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and Google. Every cut has a performance objective.
  • Motion Design: Build sharp animations and motion graphics that reinforce hooks, brand identity, and storytelling clarity.
  • Creative Variations: Produce fast, high-quality iterations across hooks, angles, formats, pacing, and lengths to fuel continuous testing.
  • AI-Powered Production: Actively use AI video, voice, image, and asset generation tools to move from concept to finished ad in hours—not days.
  • Data-Driven Editing: Review performance metrics (thumb-stop rate, hold rate, CTR, ROAS) and translate insights directly into creative decisions.
  • A/B Testing: Run structured creative experiments and iterate quickly based on results.
  • Optimization: Continuously sharpen pacing, copy overlays, hooks, captions, structure, sound design, and visual clarity.
  • Trend Awareness: Stay current on paid social trends, platform best practices, and emerging editing and AI tools.


WHAT YOU BRING

Skills that ship.

  • Experience: 3+ years editing high-performing DTC paid social ads. Strong portfolio of Meta and TikTok creatives required.
  • Editing Tools: Expert in Adobe Premiere Pro, Capcut, Davinci Resolve. Solid working knowledge of After Effects and Photoshop.
  • Motion Design: Strong command of animation, typography, transitions, sound design, pacing, color, and visual storytelling.
  • Performance Mindset: You understand what makes a direct-response ad work—hooks, clarity, messaging hierarchy, pacing, and CTA structure.
  • AI Fluency: Comfortable using AI tools daily as part of your production stack, not as a novelty.
  • Output Velocity: Able to manage multiple edits simultaneously, hit deadlines, and sustain high-quality output at scale.
  • Captions & Copy: Writes and applies accurate, compelling English captions that reinforce messaging and hooks.
  • Execution: Takes a brief to final cut independently. Moves fast without losing craft.
  • Ownership: Finds what’s missing, fixes it, and keeps work moving without being asked.
  • Collaboration: Works fluidly with the team. Takes direct feedback and turns it around fast.
  • AI Video Tools: Hands-on experience with AI-native video editing or automation tools.
  • Creative Strategy: Familiarity with direct-response creative frameworks, hook testing, and angle development.
  • Industry: Experience with DTC, healthcare, wellness, or weight-loss brands.
  • High-Volume Teams: Background in high-throughput creative environments where output volume is tied directly to performance.


NICE TO HAVE

Bonus points.

  • Industry: Experience with DTC, healthcare, wellness, or weight-loss brands.


Compensation:

  • Base salary of $1,250 per month.
  • Performance incentive based on creative performance
  • OTE $5,000 per month
